manualCompletion.note: Completed by a human through the official UI after the automated session was refused by reCAPTCHA, so the CAPTCHA gate is not what decided the outcome.

conclusion.hypothesisTested: that deposits were refused because our wallet is not a whitelisted sender, and a faucet-origin deposit would therefore be credited
conclusion.evidence: A deposit from Circle's whitelisted faucet to the correct per-user deposit address was refunded with the identical non_whitelist_refund classification as deposits from our own wallet. Three deposits, two senders, one outcome.
conclusion.actualGate: The receiving credential, not the sending address. query_institution_txs answers code 0002 'institution address is empty', so no institution address is bound to this api-id and nothing arriving at its deposit wallet can be credited.
whatWouldUnblockIt: bind an institution address to this api-id, or
